_comment: THE version of WORLDS (single source). product = the visible version series (starts at v0.1 on 25.11.2026); technical = engine/save compatibility version (project.godot application/config/version is kept equal by tools/version/sync_version.py and checked by the tests). The commit of a build is written by tools/version/sync_version.py --build (CI) into build/web/version.json and res://data/build_info.json. Strategy and history: docs/VERSIONING.md.

history.summary: Erste sichtbare Versionsnummer: Living World vertieft, Weltautorität, Phase 4 (Siedlungsgründung) in Arbeit, Gameplay-Polishing (Animationen, Innenräume, Türen, Kollisionen, Globus, Farbpalette). + Concordium (Weltratssitz) auf Kalistia: Standort, Globus, eigenes Monument-Asset, begehbare Vorschau, Neutralität und Grundstücksgrenzen.
